items.evidence: Financial results (35%)
Capital & cost management (30%)
Operating & safety performance (25%)
Lower carbon (10%)
Individual performance adjustment $305,250
Adjusted ROCE excluding special items and FX for 2023 of 13.7% was lower than Plan
Free cash flow excluding working capital – Chevron delivered $23.0 billion
Relative adjusted earnings per share – The Company's three-year adjusted earnings per share performance improvement of 50% ranked fourth
Operating expenses, excluding fuel and transportation – $21.0 billion, below Plan
Capital expenditures – 2023 organic capex totaled $15.2 billion, above Plan
Major milestone – Tengizchevroil FGP mechanical completion was achieved in 3Q23
Personal safety – Despite a year-on-year reduction in fatalities, opportunity for improvement remains
Process safety – The number of Tier 1 + Tier 2 Loss of Containment incidents exceeded Plan (unfavorable).
Net production – 3.098 million barrels of oil-equivalent per day (MMBOED) in 2023, excluding divestments, above Plan
Refinery operational availability - Slightly below Plan mainly due to unplanned downtime.
Greenhouse gas management – Identified, funded, and executed GHG reduction projects via our marginal abatement cost curve
Equity renewable fuels production – 30,000 barrels per day in 2023, above Plan
Hydrogen – In September, Chevron acquired a majority stake in ACES Delta
Carbon capture, utilization and storage: Southeast Texas stratigraphic well is ready for execution.
The MCC continues to believe TSR should be the primary pay-for-performance measure
the addition of relative ROCE Improvement as a performance measure in our performance shares further strengthens the Company's alignment
Include a negative TSR adjustment in the payout formula that reduces the payout modifier by 20%
